notes.title: Meet Tori!
notes.notes:
Meet Tori!  A young explorer of the forests around Tecnopia who is always doing acrobatics on trees and stones and even the buildings of the city to demonstrate his balance, occasionally causing trouble. Little did he know that his days of innocent mischief were about to change ... and become a great dangerous adventure.
